main.description: A temporary rule affecting one or more offers. Targeting and mechanism are independent unions, so new mechanisms and new target kinds are added without multiplying record types. The protocol advertises promotions; it does not enforce them — redemption limits, coupon consumption, eligibility, and reservation belong to transactional systems.

shopRef.description: AT URI of the shop issuing this promotion

title.description: Display name for the promotion (e.g. 'Summer Sale')

targets.description: What this promotion applies to. Multiple promotions may target the same listing; AppViews decide which are active and applicable.

mechanism.description: How the promotion alters the offer. Open union — percentage discount, fixed discount, buy-X-get-Y, free shipping, and bundle mechanisms are additive members, not new record types.

ref.description: AT URI of an app.temp.commerce.listing record

productGroupTarget.description: Targets every variant listing in a product group

ref.description: AT URI of an app.temp.commerce.productGroup record

shopTarget.description: Targets every listing published by the issuing shop

salePrice.description: Replaces the listing's base price with a temporary price for the promotion window. The listing's own price field is never rewritten.
